talk.name: v00
talk.text: ……啊，对不起！变成我一个人一直在说了呢。

talk.name: v01
talk.text: 啊，被发现了？呵呵

talk.name: v02
talk.text: 亚子在照顾病人啊。很厉害呢

talk.name: v03
talk.text: 咦？难道说，有咲～，你害羞啦？

talk.name: v04
talk.text: 嗯！一定要拍

talk.name: v05
talk.text: 诶……彩学姐！？面包呢！？

talk.name: v06
talk.text: 诶——，然后呢？你怎么办的？

talk.name: v07
talk.text: 诶？什么都不说吗？为什么？

talk.name: v08
talk.text: 这是我们给你的生日礼物

talk.name: v09
talk.text: 这个实在有点太显眼了呢。

talk.name: v10
talk.text: 那是睡着了吗？没事吧

talk.name: v11
talk.text: 我也不知道，毕竟我只听了一次

talk.name: v12
talk.text: 那就把它当作一段快乐的回忆，好好留着吧。

talk.name: v13
talk.text: 当然，香澄和惠惠也一起……

talk.name: v14
talk.text: 伊芙，我拿来了面包，要吃吗？

talk.name: v15
talk.text: 你在做什么？你认识市谷同学吗？

talk.name: v16
talk.text: 最重要的是，有一种特别的感觉呢！

talk.name: v17
talk.text: 上次多有打扰，真不好意思

talk.name: v18
talk.text: 其实我也睡不着

talk.name: v19
talk.text: 我能感觉到，她真的很喜欢巴你哦

talk.name: v20
talk.text: 等等，你误会了……

talk.name: v21
talk.text: 纯和纱南也很期待的……

talk.name: v22
talk.text: 谢谢你听我说了这么多。

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v00
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: ……啊，对不起！变成我一个人一直在说了呢。

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v01
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 啊，被发现了？呵呵

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v02
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 亚子在照顾病人啊。很厉害呢

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v03
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 咦？难道说，有咲～，你害羞啦？

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v04
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 嗯！一定要拍

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v05
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 诶……彩学姐！？面包呢！？

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v06
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 诶——，然后呢？你怎么办的？

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v07
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 诶？什么都不说吗？为什么？

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v08
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 这是我们给你的生日礼物

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v09
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 这个实在有点太显眼了呢。

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v10
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 那是睡着了吗？没事吧

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v11
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 我也不知道，毕竟我只听了一次

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v12
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 那就把它当作一段快乐的回忆，好好留着吧。

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v13
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 当然，香澄和惠惠也一起……

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v14
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 伊芙，我拿来了面包，要吃吗？

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v15
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 你在做什么？你认识市谷同学吗？

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v16
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 最重要的是，有一种特别的感觉呢！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v17
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 上次多有打扰，真不好意思

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v18
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 其实我也睡不着

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v19
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 我能感觉到，她真的很喜欢巴你哦

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v20
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 等等，你误会了……

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v21
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 纯和纱南也很期待的……

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v22
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 谢谢你听我说了这么多。
